abilities.description:
Your astromech can scan, repair, slice/hack systems, and even create diversions for you. Choose a specialty for your astromech below. Then, start a progress track to develop your bond, and make it formidable. Every time you overcome a great adventure together, mark progress. If you finish it out, your bond with your astromech becomes very strong, and all your +1 adds become +2.

  • Carry +1 Supply
  • +1 to slice/hack
  • +1 to sabotage
  • +1 to scan
